question: How do US and China CO2 per capita trends relate over 1990-2022? (A) Both trend upward (B) US declines while China rises (C) No consistent relationship. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate line chart. One series is plotted on an oversized secondary y-axis (0 to 3x its max), flattening it. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): dual axis. True answer: B (B). Bait: A (A).
